pageProps.title: Sundae Sillok Dongtan Namgwangjang Branch
pageProps.review: This is an honest visit review of Sundae Sillok, a famous restaurant in Dongtan Namgwangjang, where I personally tasted the half-sundae, half-boiled-meat menu, which has a clean and simple taste without any smell.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Half Sundae, Half Boiled Meat", "rating": 3 } --- Clean taste without any smell. But the quantity is a bit disappointing. ``` ## Review Overall, I enjoyed the meal. I intentionally didn't add extra noodles or other menus to avoid overeating. It's a menu that's good for the illusion that I ate healthily. ## Pictures
